key_catalyst: Deepening Semiconductor Selloff and AI Capex Rethink with pending mega-cap earnings
reasoning: Three primary drivers remain actively unresolved heading into the July 30 FOMC decision: the semiconductor-AI capex selloff is deepening with key mega-cap earnings still pending (Microsoft, Meta Wednesday; Amazon, Apple Thursday), the FOMC rate decision is imminent with a 29-33% hike probability and a no-guidance Fed chair creating unusual uncertainty, and the Iran conflict is actively escalating with new ballistic missile launches reported. The intraday session closed down -1.59%, confirming the market has not absorbed these risks, and multiple catalysts carry HIGH threat with clear forward event risk into the next session.
